doc: A Freeplane map: an attribute set, notes added to a self-closed node (which opens it) and removed again (which closes it), and a child node appended; FOLDED, POSITION and the hook are never touched.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
steps.expect:
<map version="freeplane 1.11.5">
<!--To view this file, download free mind mapping software Freeplane from https://www.freeplane.org -->
<node TEXT="Plan" ID="ID_1">
<hook NAME="MapStyle"/>
<node TEXT="Scope" ID="ID_2" POSITION="right"/>
<node TEXT="Risks" ID="ID_3" POSITION="left" FOLDED="true">
<node TEXT="Budget" ID="ID_4"/>
</node>
</node>
</map>

steps.doc: An attribute value is escaped as Freeplane escapes it.
steps.expect:
<map version="freeplane 1.11.5">
<!--To view this file, download free mind mapping software Freeplane from https://www.freeplane.org -->
<node TEXT="Plan" ID="ID_1">
<hook NAME="MapStyle"/>
<node TEXT="Scope & goals" ID="ID_2" POSITION="right"/>
<node TEXT="Risks" ID="ID_3" POSITION="left" FOLDED="true">
<node TEXT="Budget" ID="ID_4"/>
</node>
</node>
</map>

steps.doc: Notes on a self-closed node open it, then the notes child is written before any child node, with the map's structural newline.
steps.expect: Agree by Friday

steps.doc: Emptying the notes removes the child and the newline before it, and a node left with only whitespace closes itself again.
steps.expect:
<map version="freeplane 1.11.5">
<!--To view this file, download free mind mapping software Freeplane from https://www.freeplane.org -->
<node TEXT="Plan" ID="ID_1">
<hook NAME="MapStyle"/>
<node TEXT="Scope & goals" ID="ID_2" POSITION="right"/>
<node TEXT="Risks" ID="ID_3" POSITION="left" FOLDED="true">
<node TEXT="Budget" ID="ID_4"/>
</node>
</node>
</map>

steps.doc: A new node is the parent's last child, attributes in the order TEXT, ID.
steps.expect:
<map version="freeplane 1.11.5">
<!--To view this file, download free mind mapping software Freeplane from https://www.freeplane.org -->
<node TEXT="Plan" ID="ID_1">
<hook NAME="MapStyle"/>
<node TEXT="Scope & goals" ID="ID_2" POSITION="right"/>
<node TEXT="Risks" ID="ID_3" POSITION="left" FOLDED="true">
<node TEXT="Budget" ID="ID_4"/>
<node TEXT="Staffing" ID="ID_5"/>
</node>
</node>
</map>
